description: Get product review analytics (Yotpo, Reviews.io, or Judge.me). Reports: summary (average rating, distribution), trends (daily volume/score), top_rated (best reviewed products), lowest_rated (worst reviewed), recent (latest reviews), by_product (all reviews for a specific product — requires productId or productTitle), search (keyword search in reviews), timing (days from purchase to review), sales_impact (reviewed vs unreviewed product sales), themes (BEST FOR 'what do customers complain about?' — aggregates review text into themes like sizing/comfort/quality/shipping with complaint counts, negative share, and sample 1-2★ quotes; pass productId/productTitle to drill into one product). Prefer themes over paging raw review text.

keyword.description: For search: keyword to find in review content

productId.description: For by_product/themes: Shopify product ID (numeric or GID) to scope to one product

productTitle.description: For by_product/themes: product title (partial match, case-insensitive)

sku.description: For search: filter to specific product SKU

name: get_reviews
